props.title: Agent Self-Improvement
props.description: Heartbeat-only fallback for operator-scorecard agent-health verdict

props.title: The Problem
props.message: The weekly scorecard backport (PR #28) that merged earlier today would have permanently reported WATCH on every Monday because it depends on skill-analytics which isn't enabled here. This patches the verdict logic before the first natural run on May 11.

props.text: Why: operator-scorecard reads articles/skill-analytics-*.md for paragraph 1, but skill-analytics is not enabled in aeon-agent (0 such articles on disk). Under the original spec, agent_health_source=missing fired every run, paragraph 1 emitted INSUFFICIENT_DATA, and the worst-of-three rollup demoted the overall weekly verdict to WATCH — even on weeks where every heartbeat ran clean (the steady state on this fork). That defeats the "was this week worth it?" answer the skill is supposed to deliver.

Modified skills/operator-scorecard/SKILL.md to split step 2d into three branches:
• Branch A: skill-analytics present → original logic
• Branch B: skill-analytics missing, heartbeat present → verdict from heartbeat counts alone
• Branch C: both missing → preserved INSUFFICIENT_DATA

Article paragraph, notification line, and log line all resolve per-branch placeholders so paragraph 1 doesn't print null/null/null. Constraints adds an explicit "heartbeat-only is first-class, not a degraded mode" note so future maintainers don't revert it.

When operator-scorecard is enabled (currently shipped enabled: false, first natural run May 11 if turned on), the weekly scorecard reports a real OK/WATCH/DEGRADED verdict computed from heartbeat history instead of permanent WATCH. Heartbeat itself audits every scheduled skill against logs + Actions runs each evening, so a week of clean HEARTBEAT_OK reports is a real OK signal — not insufficient data.
